description: Returns where the New Testament quotes the Old, in either direction: give a New Testament book, chapter or verse for the Old Testament passages it quotes, or an Old Testament one for the New Testament passages that quote it. Each result carries both English texts and a link; 15 per page by default (limit 1-40, and nextOffset continues). Use when the user asks where the New Testament quotes the Old Testament, or the reverse.

limit.description: how many results to return (1-40, default 15)

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

offset.description: how many results to skip; the previous answer's nextOffset is where its page ended

name: get_quotations
title: New Testament quotations
